elvenportal.lexicon.portal0: The elves have learned to fold a whole $(thing)Alfheim gateway$() into a single block: the $(item)Elven Portal$().$(br2)Put in it whatever the elves take, and they send back their trade by the very recipes of the great gateway: $(item)livingwood$() for $(item)dreamwood$(), $(item)manasteel$() for $(item)elementium$(), $(item)mana diamonds$() for $(item)dragonstone$(), and the rest.
elvenportal.lexicon.portal1: Every trade costs $(thing)500 mana$(), as at the great gateway. The portal holds 100 000 mana and drinks it from the $(item)mana pools$() beside it and from $(item)mana spreaders$() aimed at it.$(br2)While it has mana for a trade, the portal inside its arch stands open and the keystone glows.
elvenportal.lexicon.portal2: Items go in by hand, by $(thing)hoppers and pipes$(), or thrown onto the portal. The nine slots on the left are for the elves, the nine on the right for what they send back: take it out by hand, or with a hopper beneath.$(br2)What the elves only hand back (iron, diamonds, ender pearls) the portal doesn't take at all.
elvenportal.lexicon.portal3: A pocket gateway, woven from the elves' own gifts.
elvenportal.lexicon.portal4: The elves refine $(thing)ores$() too: for every block of ore they send back its riches, about as much as a $(item)Fortune II$() pickaxe would find.
elvenportal.lexicon.portal5: Gems and dusts come back the same way: diamonds, emeralds, lapis, redstone, coal and quartz.
jei.elvenportal.info.portal: A whole Alfheim gateway in one block. Put items in (by hand, hoppers or pipes, or throw them on it) and the elves trade them by every elven trade recipe, Botania's own and any a pack adds; they also refine ores. Every trade costs 500 mana, which the portal takes from the mana pools beside it and from mana spreaders aimed at it.
